Returns structured, sourced records: name, category, th

tools.name: get_companion_app
tools.description: Get the full sourced record for one AI companion app by id (candy-ai, ourdream-ai, lovescape, gpt-girlfriend, nomi, kupid): facts, notes, the provider's own description and link. Use after search_companion_apps when an adult user wants details on a single app.

tools.name: list_guides
